blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Is poori exercise ki chaabi (key) sirf chand facts hain, is liye sawal shuru karne se pehle inhein dil mein bitha lijiye. Cube roots of unity (1 ke teen cube roots) yeh hain: \(1,\ \omega,\ \omega^{2}\), jahan \(\omega=\frac{-1+\sqrt{3}i}{2}\) aur \(\omega^{2}=\frac{-1-\sqrt{3}i}{2}\). Do sab se zaroori properties: \(\omega^{3}=1\) aur \(1+\omega+\omega^{2}=0\). Doosri property se ek term doosri taraf le jaayein to teen bohat kaam ke rewrites milte hain: \(1+\omega=-\omega^{2}\), \(1+\omega^{2}=-\omega\) aur \(\omega+\omega^{2}=-1\). Bari power \(\omega^{n}\) ko chhota karne ka tareeqa: \(n\) ko 3 se divide kijiye aur sirf remainder (baqi) rakhiye, kyunke har \(\omega^{3}\) ek 1 ban jaata hai: \(\omega^{3k}=1\), \(\omega^{3k+1}=\omega\), \(\omega^{3k+2}=\omega^{2}\). Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke \(\sqrt{-3}=\sqrt{3}\,i\). Aur agar kisi number ka ek cube root \(k\) mil jaaye to us ke teeno cube roots \(k,\ k\omega,\ k\omega^{2}\) hote hain. Jab bhi koi sawal mushkil lage, apne aap se poochiye: \"Kya main yahan \(1+\omega+\omega^{2}=0\) ya \(\omega^{3}=1\) laga sakta hoon?\" Aksar jawab haan hota hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Find the three cube roots of \(8\).
blocks.explanation: Dekhiye, yeh cube root wala sawal hai. Humein number 8 diya gaya hai aur woh tamam numbers \(x\) find karne hain jin ka cube (teesri power) 8 ho. Bohat se students sirf ek real jawab likh kar ruk jaate hain, lekin yaad rakhiye: har non-zero number ke teen cube roots hote hain, ek real aur do complex. Teeno tak pohanchne ka pakka tareeqa yeh hai: pehle \(x^{3}=8\) ko "kuch = 0" ki shakal mein likhenge, phir difference of cubes ke formula se factorize karenge. Linear factor (jis mein \(x\) ki power 1 ho) se real root milega aur quadratic factor se do complex roots. Aakhir mein complex roots ko \(\omega\) ki madad se saaf shakal mein likh denge.
steps:
Step 1: Sawal ko equation mein badlein
\[x^{3}=8\]
\[x^{3}-8=0\]
\[x^{3}-2^{3}=0\]
Kyun: 8 ka cube root woh number hai jis ka cube 8 ho, is liye \(x^{3}=8\) likha. Phir 8 ko left side par le aaye taake right side zero ho jaaye; zero ke saath hi hum factorize karke har factor ko alag alag zero rakh sakte hain. Aur 8 ko \(2^{3}\) likha taake difference of cubes ka formula saaf nazar aaye.

Step 2: Difference of cubes se factorize karein
\[a^{3}-b^{3}=(a-b)(a^{2}+ab+b^{2})\]
\[(x-2)(x^{2}+2x+4)=0\]
Kyun: Formula mein \(a=x\) aur \(b=2\) rakha, to \(ab=2x\) aur \(b^{2}=4\) bane. Ab do factors ka product zero hai, aur agar do cheezon ka product zero ho to kam az kam ek factor zaroor zero hota hai. Is liye ab dono factors ko baari baari zero rakhenge.
Dhyan dein: difference of cubes mein doosre bracket ke andar teeno terms plus hote hain, \(x^{2}+2x+4\). Yahan beech wali term par minus laga dena bohat aam ghalti hai.

Step 3: Linear factor se real root
\[x-2=0\]
\[x=2\]
Kyun: Pehla factor zero rakhte hi real cube root foran mil jaata hai. Yeh woh jawab hai jo aap pehle se jaante the: \(2\times2\times2=8\).

Step 4: Quadratic factor ko solve karein
\[x=\dfrac{-2\pm\sqrt{4-16}}{2}\]
\[x=\dfrac{-2\pm\sqrt{-12}}{2}\]
\[x=\dfrac{-2\pm2\sqrt{3}i}{2}\]
\[x=-1\pm\sqrt{3}i\]
Kyun: \(x^{2}+2x+4\) ke real factors nahin bante (discriminant \(4-16\) negative hai), is liye quadratic formula \(x=\frac{-b\pm\sqrt{b^{2}-4ac}}{2a}\) lagaya, jahan \(a=1,\ b=2,\ c=4\). Negative number ka square root yahan \(i\) le kar aata hai: \(\sqrt{-12}=\sqrt{4}\sqrt{3}\sqrt{-1}=2\sqrt{3}i\). Aakhir mein numerator ke dono terms ko 2 se divide kiya.
Dhyan dein: 2 se sirf pehli term nahin, numerator ki dono terms divide hoti hain.

Step 5: Complex roots ko omega mein likhein
\[-1+\sqrt{3}i=2\cdot\dfrac{-1+\sqrt{3}i}{2}\]
\[-1+\sqrt{3}i=2\omega\]
\[-1-\sqrt{3}i=2\omega^{2}\]
Kyun: Hum ne 2 ko bahar nikaala aur andar 2 se divide kar diya, is se value nahin badli. Ab andar bilkul \(\frac{-1+\sqrt{3}i}{2}\) bacha, jo \(\omega\) hai; isi tarah doosra \(\omega^{2}\) ban gaya. Yeh shakal yaad rakhne mein aasaan hai: 8 ke roots \(2\) ko \(1,\ \omega,\ \omega^{2}\) se multiply karke milte hain.

Tasdeeq: har root ka cube lein
\[(2\omega)^{3}=8\omega^{3}=8\]
\[(2\omega^{2})^{3}=8\omega^{6}=8\]
Kyun: \(\omega^{3}=1\) aur \(\omega^{6}=(\omega^{3})^{2}=1\), is liye dono complex roots ka cube waqai 8 aata hai (aur \(2^{3}=8\) to hai hi). Teeno roots check ho gaye.
blocks.final_answer: \(8\) ke teen cube roots: \(2,\ 2\omega,\ 2\omega^{2}\), yaani \(2,\ -1+\sqrt{3}i,\ -1-\sqrt{3}i\). Matlab: real root sirf ek hai (2), aur baqi do roots aapas mein conjugate (jora: sirf \(i\) wale hisse ka sign ulta) hain.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Find the three cube roots of \(-8\). [The book prints this part as \(8\), the same as part (i); its answer key gives the cube roots of \(-8\). See the book correction below.]
blocks.explanation: Dekhiye, yeh cube root wala sawal hai. Humein number \(-8\) diya gaya hai aur woh tamam numbers \(x\) find karne hain jin ka cube (teesri power) \(-8\) ho. Bohat se students sirf ek real jawab likh kar ruk jaate hain, lekin yaad rakhiye: har non-zero number ke teen cube roots hote hain, ek real aur do complex. Teeno tak pohanchne ka pakka tareeqa yeh hai: pehle \(x^{3}=-8\) ko "kuch = 0" ki shakal mein likhenge, phir sum of cubes ke formula se factorize karenge. Linear factor (jis mein \(x\) ki power 1 ho) se real root milega aur quadratic factor se do complex roots. Aakhir mein complex roots ko \(\omega\) ki madad se saaf shakal mein likh denge. Yahan number negative hai, is liye \(x^{3}+8=0\) banega aur difference ki jagah sum of cubes ka formula lagega.
steps:
Step 1: Sawal ko equation mein badlein
\[x^{3}=-8\]
\[x^{3}+8=0\]
\[x^{3}+2^{3}=0\]
Kyun: \(-8\) ka cube root woh number hai jis ka cube \(-8\) ho. Dono sides mein 8 jama kiya to right side zero ho gayi. Ab left side par do cubes ka sum (jama) hai, \(x^{3}+2^{3}\).

Step 2: Sum of cubes se factorize karein
\[a^{3}+b^{3}=(a+b)(a^{2}-ab+b^{2})\]
\[(x+2)(x^{2}-2x+4)=0\]
Kyun: Formula mein \(a=x\), \(b=2\) rakha. Product zero hai, is liye ek factor zaroor zero hoga.
Dhyan dein: signs ka khayal rakhiye: pehle bracket mein plus, aur doosre bracket mein sirf beech wali term minus (\(-2x\)). Sum aur difference ke formulas ke signs aapas mein mat milaiye.

Step 3: Linear factor se real root
\[x+2=0\]
\[x=-2\]
Kyun: Negative number ka real cube root bhi negative hota hai: \((-2)^{3}=(-2)(-2)(-2)=-8\). (Square root mein aisa nahin hota, lekin cube root mein odd power minus ko qaim rakhti hai.)

Step 4: Quadratic factor ko solve karein
\[x=\dfrac{2\pm\sqrt{4-16}}{2}\]
\[x=\dfrac{2\pm2\sqrt{3}i}{2}\]
\[x=1\pm\sqrt{3}i\]
Kyun: Quadratic formula mein \(a=1,\ b=-2,\ c=4\) hain, is liye \(-b=2\) bana. Andar \(\sqrt{4-16}=\sqrt{-12}=2\sqrt{3}i\), aur phir numerator ki dono terms ko 2 se divide kiya.
Dhyan dein: \(b=-2\) hai, to \(-b\) positive 2 hoga; yahan sign ki ghalti se poora jawab ulta ho jaata hai.

Step 5: Complex roots ko omega mein likhein
\[1-\sqrt{3}i=-2\cdot\dfrac{-1+\sqrt{3}i}{2}\]
\[1-\sqrt{3}i=-2\omega\]
\[1+\sqrt{3}i=-2\omega^{2}\]
Kyun: Is dafa hum ne \(-2\) bahar nikaala. Minus bahar nikaalne se andar ki har term ka sign ulat jaata hai, is liye \(1-\sqrt{3}i\) ke andar \(-1+\sqrt{3}i\) bacha, jo \(2\) se divide ho kar \(\omega\) hai. Isi tarah \(1+\sqrt{3}i=-2\omega^{2}\).

Tasdeeq: har root ka cube lein
\[(-2\omega)^{3}=-8\omega^{3}=-8\]
\[(-2\omega^{2})^{3}=-8\omega^{6}=-8\]
Kyun: Odd power (3) minus sign ko qaim rakhti hai, aur \(\omega^{3}=\omega^{6}=1\). Dono complex roots ka cube \(-8\) aaya, jawab sahih hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(-8\) ke teen cube roots: \(-2,\ -2\omega,\ -2\omega^{2}\), yaani \(-2,\ 1-\sqrt{3}i,\ 1+\sqrt{3}i\). Ghaur kijiye: yeh part (i) ke roots ke bilkul negative hain, kyunke \(-8\) bhi \(8\) ka negative hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab part (ii) mein \(8\) chhaapti hai, jo sirf part (i) ko dohrata hai. Answer key (ii) ka jawab \(\{-2,\ -2\omega,\ -2\omega^{2}\}\) deti hai, aur yeh \(-8\) ke cube roots hain; yaani print mein minus sign reh gaya aur asal number \(-8\) hai. Hum ne \(x^{3}=-8\) solve kiya. (Agar printed \(8\) hi lein to jawab part (i) wala hoga: \(2,\ 2\omega,\ 2\omega^{2}\).)

blocks.prompt: 1 (iii) Find the three cube roots of \(27\).
blocks.explanation: Dekhiye, yeh cube root wala sawal hai. Humein number 27 diya gaya hai aur woh tamam numbers \(x\) find karne hain jin ka cube (teesri power) 27 ho. Bohat se students sirf ek real jawab likh kar ruk jaate hain, lekin yaad rakhiye: har non-zero number ke teen cube roots hote hain, ek real aur do complex. Teeno tak pohanchne ka pakka tareeqa yeh hai: pehle \(x^{3}=27\) ko "kuch = 0" ki shakal mein likhenge, phir difference of cubes ke formula se factorize karenge. Linear factor (jis mein \(x\) ki power 1 ho) se real root milega aur quadratic factor se do complex roots. Aakhir mein complex roots ko \(\omega\) ki madad se saaf shakal mein likh denge. Pehle check kar lijiye ke 27 perfect cube hai: \(3\times3\times3=27\).
steps:
Step 1: Sawal ko equation mein badlein
\[x^{3}=27\]
\[x^{3}-3^{3}=0\]
Kyun: 27 ka cube root woh number hai jis ka cube 27 ho. 27 ko left par la kar right side zero ki, aur \(27=3^{3}\) likha taake difference of cubes ka formula seedha lag sake.

Step 2: Difference of cubes se factorize karein
\[(x-3)(x^{2}+3x+9)=0\]
Kyun: Formula \(a^{3}-b^{3}=(a-b)(a^{2}+ab+b^{2})\) mein \(a=x\), \(b=3\) rakha: \(ab=3x\) aur \(b^{2}=9\). Doosre bracket mein teeno terms plus hain.

Step 3: Real root
\[x-3=0\]
\[x=3\]
Kyun: Product zero ho to koi ek factor zero hota hai; pehla factor zero rakhne se real root 3 mila.

Step 4: Quadratic factor ko solve karein
\[x=\dfrac{-3\pm\sqrt{9-36}}{2}\]
\[x=\dfrac{-3\pm\sqrt{-27}}{2}\]
\[x=\dfrac{-3\pm3\sqrt{3}i}{2}\]
Kyun: Quadratic formula mein \(a=1,\ b=3,\ c=9\); \(b^{2}-4ac=9-36=-27\). Ab \(\sqrt{-27}=\sqrt{9}\sqrt{3}\sqrt{-1}=3\sqrt{3}i\). Yahan 2 se divide karne par fraction hi rehta hai, kyunke 3 aur 2 cancel nahin hote; isi shakal mein chhor dein.
Dhyan dein: \(\sqrt{27}\) ko \(3\sqrt{3}\) likhna na bhooliye; \(27=9\times3\) aur 9 ka square root 3 hai.

Step 5: Complex roots ko omega mein likhein
\[\dfrac{-3+3\sqrt{3}i}{2}=3\omega\]
\[\dfrac{-3-3\sqrt{3}i}{2}=3\omega^{2}\]
Kyun: Numerator mein 3 common hai. Use bahar nikaalein to \(3\cdot\frac{-1\pm\sqrt{3}i}{2}\) bachta hai, aur andar wali cheez bilkul \(\omega\) ya \(\omega^{2}\) hai.

Tasdeeq: har root ka cube lein
\[(3\omega)^{3}=27\omega^{3}=27\]
\[(3\omega^{2})^{3}=27\omega^{6}=27\]
Kyun: \(3^{3}=27\) aur \(\omega^{3}=\omega^{6}=1\). Teeno roots ka cube 27 hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(27\) ke teen cube roots: \(3,\ 3\omega,\ 3\omega^{2}\), yaani \(3,\ \frac{-3+3\sqrt{3}i}{2},\ \frac{-3-3\sqrt{3}i}{2}\). Pattern dekhiye: real root ko \(1,\ \omega,\ \omega^{2}\) se multiply karo, teeno roots mil jaate hain.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iv) Find the three cube roots of \(64\).
blocks.explanation: Dekhiye, yeh cube root wala sawal hai. Humein number 64 diya gaya hai aur woh tamam numbers \(x\) find karne hain jin ka cube (teesri power) 64 ho. Bohat se students sirf ek real jawab likh kar ruk jaate hain, lekin yaad rakhiye: har non-zero number ke teen cube roots hote hain, ek real aur do complex. Teeno tak pohanchne ka pakka tareeqa yeh hai: pehle \(x^{3}=64\) ko "kuch = 0" ki shakal mein likhenge, phir difference of cubes ke formula se factorize karenge. Linear factor (jis mein \(x\) ki power 1 ho) se real root milega aur quadratic factor se do complex roots. Aakhir mein complex roots ko \(\omega\) ki madad se saaf shakal mein likh denge. Yahan \(64=4^{3}\) hai, to real root 4 hoga; asal kaam do complex roots nikaalna hai.
steps:
Step 1: Sawal ko equation mein badlein
\[x^{3}=64\]
\[x^{3}-4^{3}=0\]
Kyun: 64 ka cube root woh number hai jis ka cube 64 ho, aur \(4\times4\times4=64\), is liye \(64=4^{3}\) likha. Right side zero kar di taake factorize kar sakein.
Dhyan dein: \(64=8^{2}\) bhi hai, lekin yahan humein cube chahiye, square nahin; \(8\) cube root nahin hai.

Step 2: Difference of cubes se factorize karein
\[(x-4)(x^{2}+4x+16)=0\]
Kyun: \(a=x\), \(b=4\) rakhne par \(ab=4x\) aur \(b^{2}=16\) bante hain, aur formula \((a-b)(a^{2}+ab+b^{2})\) se yeh factors mil gaye.

Step 3: Real root
\[x-4=0\]
\[x=4\]
Kyun: Pehla factor zero rakha; zero product ka matlab hai ke koi ek factor zero hai.

Step 4: Quadratic factor ko solve karein
\[x=\dfrac{-4\pm\sqrt{16-64}}{2}\]
\[x=\dfrac{-4\pm\sqrt{-48}}{2}\]
\[x=\dfrac{-4\pm4\sqrt{3}i}{2}\]
\[x=-2\pm2\sqrt{3}i\]
Kyun: Quadratic formula mein \(a=1,\ b=4,\ c=16\); \(b^{2}-4ac=16-64=-48\). Ab \(48=16\times3\), is liye \(\sqrt{-48}=\sqrt{16}\sqrt{3}\,i=4\sqrt{3}i\). Aakhir mein \(-4\) aur \(4\sqrt{3}i\) dono ko 2 se divide kiya.

Step 5: Complex roots ko omega mein likhein
\[-2+2\sqrt{3}i=4\cdot\dfrac{-1+\sqrt{3}i}{2}\]
\[-2+2\sqrt{3}i=4\omega\]
\[-2-2\sqrt{3}i=4\omega^{2}\]
Kyun: Ulti taraf se check kijiye: \(4\times\frac{-1}{2}=-2\) aur \(4\times\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}=2\sqrt{3}\). Yaani 4 bahar nikaalne se andar \(\omega\) (ya \(\omega^{2}\)) bach jaata hai.

Tasdeeq: har root ka cube lein
\[(4\omega)^{3}=64\omega^{3}=64\]
\[(4\omega^{2})^{3}=64\omega^{6}=64\]
Kyun: \(4^{3}=64\) aur \(\omega^{3}=\omega^{6}=1\). Teeno roots sahih hain.
blocks.final_answer: \(64\) ke teen cube roots: \(4,\ 4\omega,\ 4\omega^{2}\), yaani \(4,\ -2+2\sqrt{3}i,\ -2-2\sqrt{3}i\). (Answer key yahan ghalat jawab deti hai; neeche "Kitab ki ghalti" dekhiye.)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Part (iv) ke liye answer key \(\{-3,\ -3\omega,\ -3\omega^{2}\}\) chhaapti hai. Yeh \(-27\) ke cube roots hain (kyunke \((-3)^{3}=-27\)), printed \(64\) ke nahin; key ki list asal mein \(8,\ -8,\ 27,\ -27,\ 64\) ke hisaab se hai, printed numbers ke hisaab se nahin. \(64\) ke sahih cube roots \(4,\ 4\omega,\ 4\omega^{2}\) hain.

blocks.prompt: 1 (v) Find the three cube roots of \(-625\).
blocks.explanation: Yeh bhi cube root ka sawal hai, lekin ab ek nayi mushkil hai: \(-625\) perfect cube nahin hai (koi whole number aisa nahin jis ka cube 625 ho). Is liye pichle parts ki tarah whole numbers se factorize karna mushkil ho jaata hai. Behtar tareeqa yeh hai: pehle sirf ek real cube root dhoondein, aur us ke liye 625 mein se perfect cube alag karein (\(625=125\times5\)). Phir woh qaida (rule) lagayein jo pichle chaar parts mein baar baar nazar aaya: agar ek cube root \(k\) ho to teeno cube roots \(k,\ k\omega,\ k\omega^{2}\) hain. Pehle step mein hum yeh qaida saabit bhi karenge taake aap ise aankh band karke nahin, samajh kar use karein.
steps:
Step 1: k, k omega, k omega squared teeno cube roots kyun hain
\[(k\omega)^{3}=k^{3}\omega^{3}=k^{3}\]
\[(k\omega^{2})^{3}=k^{3}\omega^{6}=k^{3}\]
Kyun: \(\omega^{3}=1\) hai, is liye kisi cube root ko \(\omega\) ya \(\omega^{2}\) se multiply karne se us ka cube nahin badalta. Yeh teeno numbers aapas mein mukhtalif (different) hain, aur cubic equation (teesri degree ki equation) ke zyada se zyada teen roots hote hain, is liye yahi teeno poore cube roots hain, koi aur nahin.

Step 2: Real cube root dhoondein
\[625=125\times5\]
\[\sqrt[3]{-625}=\sqrt[3]{-125}\cdot\sqrt[3]{5}\]
\[\sqrt[3]{-625}=-5\sqrt[3]{5}\]
Kyun: 625 ko aise todha ke ek hissa perfect cube ho: \(-125=(-5)^{3}\). Product ka cube root, cube roots ka product hota hai, is liye \(\sqrt[3]{-125}=-5\) bahar aa gaya aur \(\sqrt[3]{5}\) andar reh gaya. Bilkul waise hi jaise \(\sqrt{12}=2\sqrt{3}\) karte hain, bas yahan square ki jagah cube hai.
Dhyan dein: \(625=25\times25\) se kuch nahin banta, kyunke 25 perfect cube nahin; perfect cube factor 125 hai.

Step 3: Baqi do cube roots
\[k=-5\sqrt[3]{5}\]
\[k\omega=-5\sqrt[3]{5}\,\omega\]
\[k\omega^{2}=-5\sqrt[3]{5}\,\omega^{2}\]
Kyun: Step 1 ka qaida \(k=-5\sqrt[3]{5}\) ke saath lagaya. Real root ko \(\omega\) aur \(\omega^{2}\) se multiply karte hi baqi do roots mil gaye; koi lamba quadratic formula nahin lagana para.

Step 4: Yahi roots a + ib ki shakal mein
\[-\omega=\dfrac{1-\sqrt{3}i}{2}\]
\[k\omega=\dfrac{5\sqrt[3]{5}}{2}(1-\sqrt{3}i)\]
\[k\omega^{2}=\dfrac{5\sqrt[3]{5}}{2}(1+\sqrt{3}i)\]
Kyun: \(k\omega=5\sqrt[3]{5}\cdot(-\omega)\) likh sakte hain, aur \(-\omega\), \(-\omega^{2}\) ki values \(\frac{1\mp\sqrt{3}i}{2}\) hain (minus bahar se andar jaane par har sign ulat jaata hai). Andaaza lagane ke liye: roots taqreeban \(-8.55\) aur \(4.27\mp7.40i\) hain.

Tasdeeq: real root ka cube lein
\[(-5\sqrt[3]{5})^{3}=(-5)^{3}(\sqrt[3]{5})^{3}\]
\[=-125\times5=-625\]
Kyun: Cube root ki definition hi yeh hai ke \(\sqrt[3]{5}\) ka cube 5 ho. Baqi do roots ka cube Step 1 ki wajah se khud ba khud \(-625\) hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(-625\) ke teen cube roots: \(-5\sqrt[3]{5},\ -5\sqrt[3]{5}\,\omega,\ -5\sqrt[3]{5}\,\omega^{2}\). Matlab: ek real root (taqreeban \(-8.55\)) aur us ko \(\omega\), \(\omega^{2}\) se multiply karke do complex roots.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Part (v) ke liye answer key \(\{4,\ 4\omega,\ 4\omega^{2}\}\) chhaapti hai. Yeh \(64\) (part (iv)) ke cube roots hain, printed \(-625\) ke nahin; key mein \(-625\) ka jawab hai hi nahin. \(-625\) ke sahih cube roots \(-5\sqrt[3]{5},\ -5\sqrt[3]{5}\,\omega,\ -5\sqrt[3]{5}\,\omega^{2}\) hain.

blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Evaluate \((1+\omega-\omega^{2})^{8}\). [The book prints \((1+\omega-\omega)^{8}\); see the book correction below.]
blocks.explanation: Yeh "evaluate" (value nikaalo) wala sawal hai. Expression mein \(\omega\) hai aur humein use ek saada number ya saada shakal tak le jaana hai. Hamare paas sirf do auzaar (tools) hain: \(\omega^{3}=1\) aur \(1+\omega+\omega^{2}=0\). Yahan bracket ki power 8 hai. Agar aap seedha \((1+\omega-\omega^{2})\) ko aath dafa multiply karenge to kaam bohat lamba aur ghalti ka khatra zyada hoga. Is liye plan yeh hai: pehle bracket ko ek single term mein badlein (\(1+\omega=-\omega^{2}\) se), phir power lagayein, aur aakhir mein \(\omega\) ki bari power ko 3 se divide karke chhota karein. Yaad rakhiye: power lagane se pehle bracket ko saada karna hi is sawal ki asal chaal hai.
steps:
Step 1: Bracket ko saada karein
\[1+\omega-\omega^{2}=(1+\omega)-\omega^{2}\]
\[=-\omega^{2}-\omega^{2}\]
\[=-2\omega^{2}\]
Kyun: \(1+\omega+\omega^{2}=0\) se \(1+\omega=-\omega^{2}\) milta hai, is liye 1 aur \(\omega\) ko ek group mein rakha aur un ki jagah \(-\omega^{2}\) likh diya. Ab do like terms (\(-\omega^{2}\) aur \(-\omega^{2}\)) jama karke \(-2\omega^{2}\) bana.
Dhyan dein: kis term ko kis ke saath group karna hai, yeh dekhiye. Jo do terms plus sign ke saath hon (yahan \(1\) aur \(\omega\)), unhein milaiye.

Step 2: Power 8 lagayein
\[(-2\omega^{2})^{8}=(-2)^{8}(\omega^{2})^{8}\]
\[=256\,\omega^{16}\]
Kyun: Product ki power: \((ab)^{n}=a^{n}b^{n}\). Negative number ki even power positive hoti hai, is liye \((-2)^{8}=256\). Aur power ki power mein indices multiply hote hain: \((\omega^{2})^{8}=\omega^{16}\).
Dhyan dein: \((-2)^{8}\) ko \(-256\) likhna aam ghalti hai; 8 even hai, minus khatam ho jaata hai.

Step 3: Omega ki power chhoti karein
\[\omega^{16}=(\omega^{3})^{5}\cdot\omega\]
\[\omega^{16}=\omega\]
Kyun: 16 ko 3 se divide kiya: \(16=3\times5+1\), yaani remainder 1. Har \(\omega^{3}\) ek 1 hai, is liye \((\omega^{3})^{5}=1^{5}=1\) aur sirf \(\omega^{1}\) bacha.

Step 4: Natija
\[(1+\omega-\omega^{2})^{8}=256\,\omega\]
Kyun: Step 3 ka \(\omega^{16}=\omega\) Step 2 mein rakh diya. Aath power wala lamba expression sirf ek term ban gaya.

Tasdeeq: baar baar square karke power 8 tak pohanchein
\[(-2\omega^{2})^{2}=4\omega^{4}=4\omega\]
\[(4\omega)^{2}=16\omega^{2}\]
\[(16\omega^{2})^{2}=256\omega^{4}\]
\[=256\,\omega\]
Kyun: Teen dafa square karne se 8th power milti hai (\(2\times2\times2=8\)). Har qadam par \(\omega^{4}=\omega\) use kiya. Doosre raaste se bhi wahi \(256\omega\) aaya, to jawab pakka hai.
blocks.final_answer: \((1+\omega-\omega^{2})^{8}=256\,\omega\). (Kitab mein bracket ghalat chhapa hai; neeche "Kitab ki ghalti" dekhiye.)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

Plan seedha hai: har power ko 3 se divide karke sirf remainder rakhein, phir dekhein ke kya hamare saamne \(1+\omega+\omega^{2}\) ban gaya hai.
steps:
Step 1: Dono bari powers ko chhota karein
\[\omega^{28}=(\omega^{3})^{9}\cdot\omega=\omega\]
\[\omega^{29}=(\omega^{3})^{9}\cdot\omega^{2}=\omega^{2}\]
Kyun: 28 ko 3 se divide karein to \(28=27+1\) (remainder 1), aur \(29=27+2\) (remainder 2). Ab \(\omega^{27}=(\omega^{3})^{9}=1^{9}=1\), is liye sirf remainder wali power bachti hai. Socho jaise ghari: har teen qadam ke baad hum wapas 1 par aa jaate hain.
Dhyan dein: quotient (9) se kuch nahin hota; sirf remainder dekhiye.

Step 2: Main property lagayein
\[\omega^{28}+\omega^{29}+1=\omega+\omega^{2}+1\]
\[=0\]
Kyun: Chhota karne ke baad expression bilkul \(1+\omega+\omega^{2}\) ban gaya, aur yeh cube roots of unity ki sab se mashhoor property ke mutabiq zero hai.

Tasdeeq: asal values rakh kar dekhein
\[\omega+\omega^{2}=\dfrac{-1+\sqrt{3}i}{2}+\dfrac{-1-\sqrt{3}i}{2}\]
\[\omega+\omega^{2}=-1\]
\[-1+1=0\]
Kyun: Dono fractions jama karne par imaginary parts (\(+\sqrt{3}i\) aur \(-\sqrt{3}i\)) cancel ho jaate hain aur real parts \(-\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{2}=-1\) dete hain. Is mein 1 jama kiya to 0 aaya.
blocks.final_answer: \(\omega^{28}+\omega^{29}+1=0\). Yaani itni bari powers ke bawajood jawab bilkul saada zero hai, sirf remainders ki wajah se.

steps:
Step 1: Pehle bracket ko saada karein
\[1+\omega-\omega^{2}=(1+\omega)-\omega^{2}\]
\[=-\omega^{2}-\omega^{2}=-2\omega^{2}\]
Kyun: Is bracket mein \(1\) aur \(\omega\) plus ke saath hain, to unhein milaya: \(1+\omega=-\omega^{2}\). Bilkul part (i) wala kaam hai.

Step 2: Doosre bracket ko saada karein
\[1-\omega+\omega^{2}=(1+\omega^{2})-\omega\]
\[=-\omega-\omega=-2\omega\]
Kyun: Is bracket mein plus ke saath \(1\) aur \(\omega^{2}\) hain, is liye in dono ki jori banayi: \(1+\omega^{2}=-\omega\). Phir \(-\omega-\omega=-2\omega\).
Dhyan dein: har bracket mein dekhiye ke kaun si do terms plus hain. Agar yahan bhi \(1+\omega\) uthane ki koshish karenge to sign ghalat ho jaayega.

Step 3: Dono ko multiply karein
\[(-2\omega^{2})(-2\omega)=4\omega^{3}\]
\[=4\]
Kyun: Minus times minus plus hota hai, \(2\times2=4\), aur same base ki powers multiply hon to indices jama hote hain: \(\omega^{2}\cdot\omega=\omega^{3}=1\).

Tasdeeq: doosra raasta, (1 + A)(1 - A)
\[A=\omega-\omega^{2}\]
\[(1+A)(1-A)=1-A^{2}\]
\[A^{2}=\omega^{2}-2\omega^{3}+\omega^{4}\]
\[A^{2}=\omega^{2}-2+\omega=-3\]
\[1-A^{2}=1+3=4\]
Kyun: Ghaur se dekhein to dono brackets \(1+A\) aur \(1-A\) hain, is liye \((a+b)(a-b)=a^{2}-b^{2}\) wala formula lag gaya. \(A^{2}\) nikaalne mein \(\omega^{3}=1\), \(\omega^{4}=\omega\) aur \(\omega+\omega^{2}=-1\) use kiye. Phir bhi 4 aaya.
blocks.final_answer: \((1+\omega-\omega^{2})(1-\omega+\omega^{2})=4\). Do complex brackets ka product ek saada real number nikla.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iv) Evaluate \(\left(\frac{-1+\sqrt{-3}}{2}\right)^{7}+\left(\frac{-1-\sqrt{-3}}{2}\right)^{7}\). [The book prints the first bracket as \(\frac{1+\sqrt{-3}}{2}\); see the book correction below.]

steps:
Step 1: Brackets ko pehchanein
\[\sqrt{-3}=\sqrt{3}\,i\]
\[\dfrac{-1+\sqrt{-3}}{2}=\omega\]
\[\dfrac{-1-\sqrt{-3}}{2}=\omega^{2}\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{-3}=\sqrt{3}\sqrt{-1}=\sqrt{3}i\). Is ke baad brackets bilkul \(\omega\) aur \(\omega^{2}\) ki values ban jaate hain. Jab bhi aap \(\frac{-1\pm\sqrt{-3}}{2}\) dekhein, foran sochiye: "yeh to \(\omega\) ya \(\omega^{2}\) hai."

Step 2: Dobara likhein aur powers chhoti karein
\[\omega^{7}+(\omega^{2})^{7}=\omega^{7}+\omega^{14}\]
\[\omega^{7}=(\omega^{3})^{2}\omega=\omega\]
\[\omega^{14}=(\omega^{3})^{4}\omega^{2}=\omega^{2}\]
Kyun: Power ki power mein indices multiply hote hain, \((\omega^{2})^{7}=\omega^{14}\). Phir 3 se divide kiya: \(7=6+1\) (remainder 1) aur \(14=12+2\) (remainder 2). \(\omega^{6}\) aur \(\omega^{12}\) dono 1 hain.

Step 3: Jama karein
\[\omega+\omega^{2}=-1\]
Kyun: \(1+\omega+\omega^{2}=0\) mein se 1 doosri taraf le jaayein to \(\omega+\omega^{2}=-1\) milta hai.

Step 4: Printed expression kya deti hai
\[\dfrac{1+\sqrt{-3}}{2}=-\omega^{2}\]
\[(-\omega^{2})^{7}+(\omega^{2})^{7}\]
\[=-\omega^{14}+\omega^{14}=0\]
Kyun: Kitab ne pehla bracket \(\frac{1+\sqrt{-3}}{2}\) chhapa hai. Is mein se minus bahar nikaalein to \(-\frac{-1-\sqrt{3}i}{2}=-\omega^{2}\) banta hai. Odd power (7) minus ko qaim rakhti hai, is liye dono terms ek doosre ko cancel kar deti hain aur jawab 0 aata hai. Answer key ka \(-1\) tabhi aata hai jab pehla bracket \(\frac{-1+\sqrt{-3}}{2}\) ho; is liye hum ne yahi intended (asal irada) bracket solve kiya.

Tasdeeq: conjugates ki madad se
\[\omega^{14}=\omega^{2}=\overline{\omega}\]
\[\omega+\overline{\omega}=2\operatorname{Re}(\omega)\]
\[=2\left(-\tfrac{1}{2}\right)=-1\]
Kyun: \(\omega^{2}\) asal mein \(\omega\) ka conjugate hai (real axis mein aaine ki tarah ulta). Kisi number aur us ke conjugate ka jama us ke real part ka do guna hota hai, aur \(\omega\) ka real part \(-\frac{1}{2}\) hai. Phir se \(-1\) aaya.
blocks.final_answer: \(-1\) (bilkul printed expression, yaani pehle bracket \(\frac{1+\sqrt{-3}}{2}\) ke saath, ki value \(0\) hai). Matlab: \(\omega^{7}+\omega^{14}\) asal mein \(\omega+\omega^{2}\) hi hai.

blocks.explanation: Yeh "evaluate" (value nikaalo) wala sawal hai. Expression mein \(\omega\) hai aur humein use ek saada number ya saada shakal tak le jaana hai. Is liye brackets \(\omega\) aur \(\omega^{2}\) nahin balke \(2\omega\) aur \(2\omega^{2}\) hain. Plan: brackets ko \(\omega\) mein likhein, power 5 lagayein (2 ki power alag aur \(\omega\) ki power alag), \(\omega\) ki powers chhoti karein aur \(\omega+\omega^{2}=-1\) lagayein. Kitab ka printed bracket kya deta hai, woh bhi alag step mein dekhenge.
steps:
Step 1: Har bracket ko omega mein likhein
\[-1+\sqrt{-3}=-1+\sqrt{3}i=2\omega\]
\[-1-\sqrt{-3}=-1-\sqrt{3}i=2\omega^{2}\]
Kyun: \(-1+\sqrt{3}i=2\cdot\frac{-1+\sqrt{3}i}{2}=2\omega\). Hum ne 2 se divide bhi kiya aur multiply bhi, is liye value wahi rahi; doosre bracket ke saath bhi yahi kiya.

Step 2: Power 5 lagayein
\[(2\omega)^{5}+(2\omega^{2})^{5}\]
\[=32\omega^{5}+32\omega^{10}\]
\[=32(\omega^{5}+\omega^{10})\]
Kyun: \((ab)^{5}=a^{5}b^{5}\), is liye \(2^{5}=32\) alag aur \(\omega\) ki power alag. \((\omega^{2})^{5}=\omega^{10}\). Phir 32 dono terms mein common tha, use bahar nikaal liya.
Dhyan dein: \(2^{5}\) ko \(10\) likhna (\(2\times5\)) aam ghalti hai; \(2^{5}=2\times2\times2\times2\times2=32\).

Step 3: Powers chhoti karein aur jama karein
\[\omega^{5}=\omega^{3}\omega^{2}=\omega^{2}\]
\[\omega^{10}=(\omega^{3})^{3}\omega=\omega\]
\[32(\omega^{2}+\omega)=32(-1)\]
\[=-32\]
Kyun: \(5=3+2\) (remainder 2) aur \(10=9+1\) (remainder 1). Ab bracket mein \(\omega+\omega^{2}\) bana jo \(-1\) hai.

Step 4: Printed expression kya deti hai
\[1+\sqrt{-3}=-2\omega^{2}\]
\[(-2\omega^{2})^{5}+(2\omega^{2})^{5}=0\]
Kyun: Kitab ne pehla bracket \((1+\sqrt{-3})\) chhapa hai. \(1+\sqrt{3}i=-(-1-\sqrt{3}i)=-2\omega^{2}\). Odd power 5 minus ko qaim rakhti hai, is liye dono terms cancel ho jaati hain aur jawab 0 aata hai. Answer key ka \(-32\) tabhi aata hai jab bracket \((-1+\sqrt{-3})\) ho.

Tasdeeq: conjugates ki madad se
\[(2\omega)^{5}=32\omega^{2}\]
\[(2\omega^{2})^{5}=32\omega=\overline{32\omega^{2}}\]
\[\text{sum}=2\operatorname{Re}(32\omega^{2})\]
\[=64\left(-\tfrac{1}{2}\right)=-32\]
Kyun: Dono terms aapas mein conjugate hain, aur conjugates ka jama real part ka do guna hota hai. \(\omega^{2}\) ka real part \(-\frac{1}{2}\) hai, is liye \(2\times32\times(-\frac{1}{2})=-32\).
blocks.final_answer: \(-32\) (bilkul printed expression, yaani pehle bracket \((1+\sqrt{-3})\) ke saath, ki value \(0\) hai). Ghaur kijiye: jawab real hai, kyunke do conjugates ka jama hamesha real hota hai.

blocks.explanation: Yeh identity (aisa bayan jo letters ki har value ke liye sach ho) saabit karne wala sawal hai. Humein dikhana hai ke left-hand side (L.H.S.) aur right-hand side (R.H.S.) barabar hain. Qaida yeh hai ke hamesha mushkil side se shuru karein, yahan woh side jis mein \(\omega\) hai, kyunke use saada karna aasaan hai, ulta nahin. Plan: R.H.S. ke do \(\omega\) wale brackets ko pehle multiply karein, \(\omega+\omega^{2}=-1\) aur \(\omega^{3}=1\) se \(\omega\) ko ghaib karein, aur phir \((x-y)\) se multiply karke L.H.S. tak pohanchein. Yeh asal mein difference of cubes ka formula hi hai, bas doosre bracket ko \(\omega\) ki madad se do linear factors mein tod diya gaya hai.
steps:
Step 1: R.H.S. ke do omega wale brackets multiply karein
\[(x-\omega y)(x-\omega^{2}y)\]
\[=x^{2}-\omega^{2}xy-\omega xy\]
\[\quad+\omega^{3}y^{2}\]
Kyun: Ek bracket ki har term ko doosre bracket ki har term se multiply kiya (chaar products). Aakhri product mein \((-\omega y)(-\omega^{2}y)=\omega^{3}y^{2}\), kyunke minus times minus plus hai aur \(\omega\cdot\omega^{2}=\omega^{3}\).
Dhyan dein: \(\omega\) ko bhi ek number ki tarah treat kijiye; us ki power alag rakhiye aur \(x,\ y\) ki powers alag.

Step 2: Omega ko ghaib karein
\[=x^{2}-(\omega+\omega^{2})xy+\omega^{3}y^{2}\]
\[=x^{2}+xy+y^{2}\]
Kyun: Beech ki do terms mein \(xy\) common tha, use bahar nikaala to bracket mein \(\omega+\omega^{2}\) bana jo \(-1\) hai; minus times minus se \(+xy\). Aur \(\omega^{3}=1\) se \(\omega^{3}y^{2}=y^{2}\). Dekhiye, \(\omega\) poori tarah gaya aur woh jaana pehchana bracket aa gaya jo difference of cubes mein hota hai.

Step 3: Pehle bracket se multiply karein
\[(x-y)(x^{2}+xy+y^{2})\]
\[=x^{3}+x^{2}y+xy^{2}\]
\[\quad-x^{2}y-xy^{2}-y^{3}\]
\[=x^{3}-y^{3}\]
Kyun: Pehle \(x\) ko bracket ki teeno terms se multiply kiya, phir \(-y\) ko. \(x^{2}y\) aur \(-x^{2}y\), aur \(xy^{2}\) aur \(-xy^{2}\) jori jori cancel ho gaye; sirf \(x^{3}-y^{3}\) bacha, jo L.H.S. hai.

Tasdeeq: x = 2, y = 1 rakh kar dekhein
\[\text{L.H.S.}=8-1=7\]
\[(2-\omega)(2-\omega^{2})\]
\[=4-2(\omega+\omega^{2})+\omega^{3}\]
\[=4+2+1=7\]
Kyun: \(x-y=1\) hai, is liye R.H.S. sirf aakhri do brackets ka product reh gaya. Dono sides 7 aayeen. Numbers rakh kar check karna identity ki ek achhi jaanch hai (lekin yeh saboot nahin, saboot upar wale steps hain).
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(x^{3}-y^{3}=(x-y)(x-\omega y)(x-\omega^{2}y)\). Matlab: \(\omega\) ki madad se \(x^{3}-y^{3}\) teen linear factors mein toot jaata hai.

blocks.explanation: Yeh identity (aisa bayan jo letters ki har value ke liye sach ho) saabit karne wala sawal hai. Humein dikhana hai ke left-hand side (L.H.S.) aur right-hand side (R.H.S.) barabar hain. Qaida yeh hai ke hamesha mushkil side se shuru karein, yahan woh side jis mein \(\omega\) hai, kyunke use saada karna aasaan hai, ulta nahin. Yeh part lamba hai lekin mushkil nahin; bas tartib (order) se chalna hai. Plan: pehle R.H.S. ke do \(\omega\) wale brackets ko row by row multiply karein (nau products), \(\omega^{3}=1\), \(\omega^{4}=\omega\) aur \(\omega+\omega^{2}=-1\) se \(\omega\) ghaib karein, phir \((x+y+z)\) se multiply karke cancel hone wali terms ko hata dein.
steps:
Step 1: Do omega wale brackets ko row by row multiply karein
\[x(\ldots)=x^{2}+\omega^{2}xy+\omega xz\]
\[\omega y(\ldots)=\omega xy+\omega^{3}y^{2}+\omega^{2}yz\]
\[\omega^{2}z(\ldots)=\omega^{2}xz+\omega^{4}yz+\omega^{3}z^{2}\]
Kyun: \((x+\omega y+\omega^{2}z)\) ki har term ko poore bracket \((x+\omega^{2}y+\omega z)\) se multiply kiya, ek line mein ek term. Is tarah nau products teen saaf lines mein aa gaye aur koi term chhooti nahin. Lambe multiplication mein yeh row by row tareeqa ghaltiyan bohat kam kar deta hai.

Step 2: Like terms ikatthi karein aur omega ghaib karein
\[x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\]
\[+(\omega+\omega^{2})xy\]
\[+(\omega^{2}+\omega)yz\]
\[+(\omega+\omega^{2})zx\]
\[=x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}-xy-yz-zx\]
Kyun: Pehle \(\omega^{3}=1\) aur \(\omega^{4}=\omega^{3}\cdot\omega=\omega\) lagaya. Phir \(xy\) wali do terms, \(yz\) wali do terms aur \(zx\) wali do terms ko ikattha kiya; har jori ka coefficient (saath laga number) \(\omega+\omega^{2}\) bana, jo \(-1\) hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\omega^{4}yz\) ko \(\omega yz\) mein badalna na bhooliye, warna \(yz\) wali jori nahin banegi.

Step 3: (x + y + z) se multiply karein
\[x(\ldots)=x^{3}+xy^{2}+xz^{2}\]
\[\quad-x^{2}y-xyz-x^{2}z\]
\[y(\ldots)=x^{2}y+y^{3}+yz^{2}\]
\[\quad-xy^{2}-y^{2}z-xyz\]
\[z(\ldots)=x^{2}z+y^{2}z+z^{3}\]
\[\quad-xyz-yz^{2}-xz^{2}\]
Kyun: \(x\), \(y\) aur \(z\) ko baari baari \(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}-xy-yz-zx\) ki chhe terms se multiply kiya. Phir se row by row, taake har line mein chhe terms hon aur ginti asaan rahe.

Step 4: Teeno lines jama karein
\[=x^{3}+y^{3}+z^{3}-3xyz\]
\[=\text{L.H.S.}\]
Kyun: \(xy^{2}\), \(x^{2}y\), \(x^{2}z\), \(xz^{2}\), \(y^{2}z\), \(yz^{2}\) jaisi har term ek line mein plus aur doosri line mein minus ke saath aati hai, is liye cancel ho jaati hai. Sirf teen cubes aur teen dafa \(-xyz\) bachte hain, yaani \(-3xyz\).
Dhyan dein: cancel karte waqt har term par nishaan lagaate jaiye; \(-xyz\) teeno lines mein hai, use cancel nahin karna balke jama karna hai.

Tasdeeq: x = 1, y = 0, z = 0 rakhein
\[\text{L.H.S.}=1\]
\[\text{R.H.S.}=(1)(1)(1)=1\]
Kyun: Dono sides barabar aayeen. Ek aur jaanch: \(x=y=z=1\) rakhein to L.H.S. \(1+1+1-3=0\), aur R.H.S. mein \(1+\omega+\omega^{2}=0\) wala bracket aa jaata hai, to woh bhi 0. Dono jaanchein theek hain.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(x^{3}+y^{3}+z^{3}-3xyz=(x+y+z)(x+\omega y+\omega^{2}z)(x+\omega^{2}y+\omega z)\). Yaani yeh mashhoor expression bhi \(\omega\) ki madad se teen linear factors mein toot jaata hai.

blocks.explanation: Yahan ek lamba product hai jis ke \(2n\) factors hain, aur humein dikhana hai ke poora product 1 hai. Itne saare factors dekh kar ghabraiye nahin; asal baat pattern pehchanna hai. Plan: har factor mein \(\omega\) ki power ko 3 se divide karke chhota karein. Phir aap dekhenge ke factors sirf do qisam ke hain, \((1+\omega)\) aur \((1+\omega^{2})\), jo baari baari aate hain. Ek jori ki value nikaal lein, phir jorian gin lein.
steps:
Step 1: Powers chhoti karein
\[\omega^{4}=\omega^{3}\cdot\omega=\omega\]
\[\omega^{8}=\omega^{6}\cdot\omega^{2}=\omega^{2}\]
\[\omega^{16}=\omega^{15}\cdot\omega=\omega\]
Kyun: Powers 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, ... har dafa double hoti hain, yaani har agli power pichli ka square hai. \(\omega\) ka square \(\omega^{2}\) hai, aur \(\omega^{2}\) ka square \(\omega^{4}=\omega\) hai. Is liye chhoti ki hui powers baari baari \(\omega,\ \omega^{2},\ \omega,\ \omega^{2},\ldots\) aati hain.

Step 2: Product dobara likhein
\[(1+\omega)(1+\omega^{2})\cdot(1+\omega)(1+\omega^{2})\cdots\]
Kyun: Step 1 ke baad har do factors ki ek jaisi jori ban gayi: pehle \((1+\omega)\), phir \((1+\omega^{2})\), phir dobara wahi.

Step 3: Ek jori ki value
\[(1+\omega)(1+\omega^{2})=(-\omega^{2})(-\omega)\]
\[=\omega^{3}=1\]
Kyun: \(1+\omega=-\omega^{2}\) aur \(1+\omega^{2}=-\omega\) (dono \(1+\omega+\omega^{2}=0\) se). Minus times minus plus hai, aur \(\omega^{2}\cdot\omega=\omega^{3}=1\).

Step 4: Jorian ginein
\[2n\text{ factors}=n\text{ pairs}\]
\[\text{Product}=1^{n}=1\]
Kyun: \(2n\) factors ki \(n\) jorian banti hain aur har jori 1 hai. 1 ko kitni bhi dafa multiply karein, 1 hi rehta hai.
Dhyan dein: yeh is liye kaam karta hai ke factors ki tadaad even (\(2n\)) hai. Agar odd hoti to aakhir mein ek akela \((1+\omega)\) bach jaata.

Tasdeeq: n = 1 seedha multiply karke
\[(1+\omega)(1+\omega^{2})=1+\omega+\omega^{2}+\omega^{3}\]
\[=0+1=1\]
Kyun: Shortcut ke baghair pehli jori ko seedha khola: pehli teen terms ka jama 0 hai aur \(\omega^{3}=1\). Wahi 1 aaya.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(2n\) factors ka product \(1\) hai. Matlab: har \((1+\omega)(1+\omega^{2})\) wali jori 1 ke barabar hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 If \(\omega\) is a root of \(x^{2}+x+1=0\), show that its other root is \(\omega^{2}\) and hence prove that \(\omega^{3}=1\).
blocks.explanation: Yeh quadratic equation ke roots wala sawal hai. Humein bataya gaya hai ke \(\omega\) equation \(x^{2}+x+1=0\) ka ek root hai; humein doosra root find karna hai aur phir \(\omega^{3}=1\) saabit karna hai. Yahan woh do formulas kaam aate hain jo aap roots ke baare mein parh chuke hain: \(ax^{2}+bx+c=0\) ke roots ka sum (jama) \(-\frac{b}{a}\) aur product (zarb) \(\frac{c}{a}\) hota hai. Plan: pehle likhein ke "\(\omega\) root hai" ka matlab kya hai, phir sum of roots se doosra root nikaalein, aur aakhir mein product of roots se \(\omega^{3}=1\) saabit karein.
steps:
Step 1: "Omega root hai" ka matlab
\[\omega^{2}+\omega+1=0\]
\[\omega^{2}=-1-\omega\]
Kyun: Root woh value hai jo \(x\) ki jagah rakhne se equation sach ho jaaye. Is liye \(x\) ki jagah \(\omega\) rakha. Phir \(\omega^{2}\) ko akela kiya; yeh shakal agle step mein kaam aayegi.

Step 2: Sum of roots se doosra root
\[\omega+\beta=-\dfrac{b}{a}=-1\]
\[\beta=-1-\omega\]
\[\beta=\omega^{2}\]
Kyun: Is equation mein \(a=b=c=1\) hain. Doosre root ko \(\beta\) (beta) kaha. Sum of roots se \(\beta=-1-\omega\) mila, aur Step 1 batata hai ke \(-1-\omega\) bilkul \(\omega^{2}\) hai. Is liye doosra root \(\omega^{2}\) hai.

Step 3: Product of roots se omega cubed = 1
\[\omega\cdot\beta=\dfrac{c}{a}=1\]
\[\omega\cdot\omega^{2}=1\]
\[\omega^{3}=1\]
Kyun: Ab dono roots maloom hain, \(\omega\) aur \(\omega^{2}\). Un ka product \(\frac{c}{a}=1\) hona chahiye. Same base ki powers multiply karne par indices jama hote hain: \(\omega^{1+2}=\omega^{3}\).
Dhyan dein: product of roots \(\frac{c}{a}\) hai, \(-\frac{c}{a}\) nahin; minus sirf sum wale formula mein hai.

Tasdeeq: omega squared bhi equation ko satisfy karta hai
\[(\omega^{2})^{2}+\omega^{2}+1=\omega^{4}+\omega^{2}+1\]
\[=\omega+\omega^{2}+1=0\]
Kyun: \(\omega^{3}=1\) se \(\omega^{4}=\omega\). Rakhne par expression zero aaya, yaani \(\omega^{2}\) waqai root hai. (Ek aur raasta: \(x^{3}-1=(x-1)(x^{2}+x+1)\), to jo bhi \(x^{2}+x+1\) ko zero kare woh \(x^{3}-1\) ko bhi zero karega, yaani \(\omega^{3}-1=0\).)
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: doosra root \(\omega^{2}\) hai, aur \(\omega^{3}=1\). Matlab: \(x^{2}+x+1=0\) ke dono roots hi 1 ke complex cube roots hain.

blocks.prompt: 5 (a) [the book does not label the parts] Prove that complex cube roots of \(-1\) are \(\frac{-1+\sqrt{3}i}{2}\) and \(\frac{-1-\sqrt{3}i}{2}\); and hence prove that \(\left(\frac{-1+\sqrt{-3}}{2}\right)^{9}+\left(\frac{1-\sqrt{-3}}{2}\right)^{9}=-2\). [As printed; the statement has two misprints, see the book correction below.]
blocks.explanation: Is sawal mein do daawe (claims) hain: pehla, \(-1\) ke complex cube roots kya hain; doosra, ek ninth power wale jama ki value. Achha student kitab ki baat ko bhi khud check karta hai, aur yahan yahi karna hai: hum khud \(x^{3}=-1\) solve karenge, nikle hue roots ko printed roots se milayenge, sahih roots ko \(\omega\) mein likhenge aur phir ninth powers nikaalenge. Aap dekhenge ke printed roots aur printed pehla bracket dono ghalat hain, is liye hum sahih (corrected) bayan saabit karenge aur yeh bhi dikhayenge ke printed shakal kya deti hai.
steps:
Step 1: x cubed = -1 solve karein
\[x^{3}=-1\]
\[x^{3}+1=0\]
\[(x+1)(x^{2}-x+1)=0\]
Kyun: \(-1\) ka cube root woh hai jis ka cube \(-1\) ho. Right side zero ki, phir sum of cubes \(a^{3}+b^{3}=(a+b)(a^{2}-ab+b^{2})\) lagaya, \(a=x\), \(b=1\) ke saath.

Step 2: Real root aur complex roots
\[x+1=0\Rightarrow x=-1\]
\[x=\dfrac{1\pm\sqrt{1-4}}{2}\]
\[x=\dfrac{1\pm\sqrt{3}i}{2}\]
Kyun: Pehla factor real root \(-1\) deta hai. \(x^{2}-x+1=0\) par quadratic formula lagaya, \(a=1,\ b=-1,\ c=1\), is liye \(-b=+1\) aur \(\sqrt{1-4}=\sqrt{-3}=\sqrt{3}i\). Yaani \(-1\) ke complex cube roots \(\frac{1\pm\sqrt{3}i}{2}\) hain: numerator mein \(+1\) hai, \(-1\) nahin.

Step 3: Printed roots ko test karein
\[\left(\dfrac{-1+\sqrt{3}i}{2}\right)^{3}=\omega^{3}=1\]
\[\left(\dfrac{-1-\sqrt{3}i}{2}\right)^{3}=\omega^{6}=1\]
Kyun: Kitab ke chhape hue numbers to \(\omega\) aur \(\omega^{2}\) hain, aur un ka cube \(+1\) hai, \(-1\) nahin. Yaani yeh 1 ke cube roots hain, \(-1\) ke nahin; is liye printed daawa saabit ho hi nahin sakta.
Dhyan dein: \(\omega\) aur \(-\omega\) mein sirf ek sign ka farq hai, lekin cube lene par jawab \(1\) aur \(-1\) ho jaata hai. Signs par hamesha nazar rakhiye.

Step 4: Sahih roots ko omega mein likhein
\[\dfrac{1+\sqrt{3}i}{2}=-\dfrac{-1-\sqrt{3}i}{2}=-\omega^{2}\]
\[\dfrac{1-\sqrt{3}i}{2}=-\dfrac{-1+\sqrt{3}i}{2}=-\omega\]
\[(-\omega)^{3}=-\omega^{3}=-1\]
Kyun: Minus bahar nikaalne se upar (numerator) ka har sign ulat jaata hai, is liye sahih roots \(-\omega^{2}\) aur \(-\omega\) bane. Aakhri line tasdeeq karti hai ke \(-\omega\) ka cube waqai \(-1\) hai (odd power minus rakhti hai); \(-\omega^{2}\) ke saath bhi yahi hota hai.

Step 5: Ninth powers (sahih bayan)
\[\left(\dfrac{1+\sqrt{-3}}{2}\right)^{9}=(-\omega^{2})^{9}\]
\[=-\omega^{18}=-1\]
\[\left(\dfrac{1-\sqrt{-3}}{2}\right)^{9}=(-\omega)^{9}\]
\[=-\omega^{9}=-1\]
\[\text{Sum}=-1+(-1)=-2\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{-3}=\sqrt{3}i\), is liye yeh brackets wahi \(-1\) ke cube roots hain jo Step 4 mein mile. 9 odd hai, to minus qaim raha. \(\omega^{18}=(\omega^{3})^{6}=1\) aur \(\omega^{9}=(\omega^{3})^{3}=1\). Jama \(-2\) aaya, jo kitab ka jawab hai.

Step 6: Printed jama kya deta hai
\[\dfrac{-1+\sqrt{-3}}{2}=\omega\]
\[\omega^{9}+(-\omega)^{9}=1-1=0\]
Kyun: Kitab ne pehla bracket \(\frac{-1+\sqrt{-3}}{2}\) chhapa hai, jo \(\omega\) hai. Is ke saath jama 0 aata hai, \(-2\) nahin. \(-2\) tabhi aata hai jab pehla bracket \(\frac{1+\sqrt{-3}}{2}\) ho, jo Step 2 ke sahih roots se bhi milta hai.

Tasdeeq: numbers se
\[\left(\dfrac{1+\sqrt{3}i}{2}\right)^{3}=-1\]
\[\left(\dfrac{1+\sqrt{3}i}{2}\right)^{9}=(-1)^{3}=-1\]
Kyun: Ninth power teen dafa cube lene ke barabar hai (\(3\times3=9\)), aur \(-1\) ka cube \(-1\) hai. Conjugate bracket ke saath bhi yahi hota hai, is liye jama \(-2\) hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(-1\) ke complex cube roots \(\frac{1+\sqrt{3}i}{2}\) aur \(\frac{1-\sqrt{3}i}{2}\) hain (yaani \(-\omega^{2}\) aur \(-\omega\)); is liye \(\left(\frac{1+\sqrt{-3}}{2}\right)^{9}+\left(\frac{1-\sqrt{-3}}{2}\right)^{9}=-2\). (Printed pehle bracket \(\frac{-1+\sqrt{-3}}{2}\) ke saath jama \(0\) hai.) Yaad rakhiye: \(-1\) ke cube roots, 1 ke cube roots ke negatives hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab \(-1\) ke complex cube roots \(\frac{-1+\sqrt{3}i}{2}\) aur \(\frac{-1-\sqrt{3}i}{2}\) chhaapti hai; yeh \(\omega\) aur \(\omega^{2}\) hain jin ka cube \(+1\) hai. \(-1\) ke sahih complex cube roots \(\frac{1+\sqrt{3}i}{2}\) aur \(\frac{1-\sqrt{3}i}{2}\) hain. Kitab ninth power ka pehla bracket bhi \(\frac{-1+\sqrt{-3}}{2}\) chhaapti hai; is ke saath jama \(1+(-1)=0\) aata hai. \(-2\) ka jawab \(\left(\frac{1+\sqrt{-3}}{2}\right)^{9}+\left(\frac{1-\sqrt{-3}}{2}\right)^{9}\) ke liye sahih hai.

blocks.prompt: 5 (b) Prove that \((-1+\sqrt{-3})^{4}+(-1-\sqrt{-3})^{4}=16\). [As printed; see the book correction below.]
blocks.explanation: Is part mein humein fourth powers ke ek jama ki value nikaalni hai. Brackets jaane pehchane hain: Sawal 2 (v) ki tarah \(-1\pm\sqrt{-3}\) asal mein \(2\omega\) aur \(2\omega^{2}\) hain. Plan: brackets ko \(\omega\) mein likhein, power 4 lagayein, powers ko 3 se divide karke chhota karein aur \(\omega+\omega^{2}=-1\) lagayein. Pehle se bata doon: sahih value \(-16\) aati hai, kitab ka printed 16 nahin; isi liye hum aakhir mein \(\omega\) ke baghair seedha hisaab karke bhi tasdeeq karenge.
steps:
Step 1: Brackets ko 2 omega aur 2 omega squared likhein
\[-1+\sqrt{-3}=-1+\sqrt{3}i=2\omega\]
\[-1-\sqrt{-3}=-1-\sqrt{3}i=2\omega^{2}\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{-3}=\sqrt{3}i\). Phir 2 bahar nikaalne se andar \(\frac{-1\pm\sqrt{3}i}{2}\) bachta hai, jo \(\omega\) ya \(\omega^{2}\) hai.

Step 2: Power 4 lagayein aur chhota karein
\[(2\omega)^{4}+(2\omega^{2})^{4}=16\omega^{4}+16\omega^{8}\]
\[=16(\omega+\omega^{2})\]
\[=16(-1)=-16\]
Kyun: \(2^{4}=16\). \(\omega^{4}=\omega^{3}\omega=\omega\) (remainder 1) aur \(\omega^{8}=\omega^{6}\omega^{2}=\omega^{2}\) (remainder 2). 16 common nikaala to bracket mein \(\omega+\omega^{2}=-1\) bana.
Dhyan dein: aakhri qadam mein \(-1\) ka sign mat chhoriye; yahi minus kitab mein reh gaya hai.

Tasdeeq: omega ke baghair seedha hisaab
\[(-1+\sqrt{3}i)^{2}=1-2\sqrt{3}i-3\]
\[=-2-2\sqrt{3}i\]
\[(-2-2\sqrt{3}i)^{2}=4+8\sqrt{3}i-12\]
\[=-8+8\sqrt{3}i\]
\[(-1-\sqrt{3}i)^{4}=-8-8\sqrt{3}i\]
\[\text{Sum}=-16\]
Kyun: Do dafa square karne se fourth power milti hai; har square mein \((a+b)^{2}=a^{2}+2ab+b^{2}\) aur \(i^{2}=-1\) use kiya. Doosra bracket pehle ka conjugate hai, is liye us ki fourth power bhi conjugate hai. Imaginary parts cancel hue aur \(-8-8=-16\) aaya.
blocks.final_answer: \((-1+\sqrt{-3})^{4}+(-1-\sqrt{-3})^{4}=-16\), printed \(16\) nahin. Matlab: kitab ka bayan sirf ek minus sign ki wajah se ghalat hai; sahih bayan \(=-16\) hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab \((-1+\sqrt{-3})^{4}+(-1-\sqrt{-3})^{4}=16\) saabit karne ko kehti hai. Sahih value \(-16\) hai: jama \(16(\omega+\omega^{2})=16(-1)\) banta hai. Print mein minus sign reh gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: 6 If \(\omega\) is a cube root of unity, form an equation whose roots are \(2\omega\) and \(2\omega^{2}\).
blocks.explanation: Is sawal mein roots diye gaye hain aur humein ulta kaam karna hai: un roots se quadratic equation banani hai. Iska seedha formula hai: agar roots ka sum \(S\) aur product \(P\) ho to equation \(x^{2}-Sx+P=0\) hoti hai. Yahan \(\omega\) se muraad complex cube root of unity hai (agar \(\omega=1\) lete to dono roots 2 ho jaate aur sawal be-maani hota). Plan: \(\omega+\omega^{2}=-1\) aur \(\omega^{3}=1\) se \(S\) aur \(P\) nikaalein, phir formula mein rakh dein.
steps:
Step 1: Roots ka sum
\[S=2\omega+2\omega^{2}\]
\[=2(\omega+\omega^{2})\]
\[=2(-1)=-2\]
Kyun: Dono terms mein 2 common tha, use bahar nikaala. Bracket mein \(\omega+\omega^{2}\) bana, jo \(-1\) hai.

Step 2: Roots ka product
\[P=(2\omega)(2\omega^{2})\]
\[=4\omega^{3}=4\]
Kyun: Numbers ko numbers se multiply kiya (\(2\times2=4\)) aur \(\omega\) ki powers jama kin (\(1+2=3\)); \(\omega^{3}=1\). \(\omega\) dono jagah ghaib ho gaya, is liye equation ke coefficients real aayenge.

Step 3: Equation banayein
\[x^{2}-Sx+P=0\]
\[x^{2}-(-2)x+4=0\]
\[x^{2}+2x+4=0\]
Kyun: Jis quadratic ke roots \(\alpha,\beta\) hon woh \((x-\alpha)(x-\beta)=x^{2}-(\alpha+\beta)x+\alpha\beta\) hai, yahi \(x^{2}-Sx+P\) hai.
Dhyan dein: formula mein \(S\) se pehle minus hai. \(S=-2\) rakhne par \(-(-2)=+2\) banta hai; yahan \(x^{2}-2x+4\) likh dena bohat aam ghalti hai.

Tasdeeq: equation solve karke dekhein
\[x=\dfrac{-2\pm\sqrt{4-16}}{2}\]
\[x=-1\pm\sqrt{3}i\]
Kyun: Yeh bilkul \(2\omega\) aur \(2\omega^{2}\) hain, jo humein Sawal 1 (i) mein mile the. Banayi hui equation ke roots wahi nikle jo diye gaye the, to equation sahih hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(x^{2}+2x+4=0\). Dilchasp baat: yeh wahi quadratic factor hai jo Sawal 1 (i) mein \(x^{3}-8\) ko factorize karte waqt bana tha.
